profile.headline: Software Engineer at AstreaX
profile.summary:
I'm currently a Software Engineer at AstreaX. I am a graduate of the University of Michigan- Ann Arbor, where I studied Information Technology with a double minor in Computer Science and Latino Studies. I was in the UX path in the School of Information, with a focus on front-end development. 

I have experience in both front and back-end development, with Python, C++, and HTML/CSS, as well as platforms such as Wordpress and XCode. I am interested in UX/UI design, software engineering, and web design.

Reach out to me at jazmynrivera19@gmail.com, and check out my work at https://jazmynrivera.github.io/portfolio.

positions.title: ADUE Web Developer
positions.description: Team lead for 12 web developers working on websites from scratch for the Associate Dean of Undergraduate Education. Lead developers through UX design process into development of sites in Wordpress, using HTML/CSS/JS.

positions.title: Programming Analyst
positions.description: Maintaining web application using HTML/CSS for front end and C#/.NET for backend for doctors to digitally keep track of patient records, and SQL database that backs the application.

positions.title: FinTech Intern
positions.description: Working on the front-end development, using HTML/CSS and Javascript, of a software for the Assets and Income team of the financial technology department.

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description: "ArtsEngine’s mission is to inspire, foster, and strengthen intellectual collisions and durable collaborative practices driven by the arts, to fully maximize the potential of each student and faculty member on North Campus and at the University of Michigan."

volunteerExperiences.description: A group from the University of Michigan chapter of SHPE volunteered in Costa Rica to teach English to school kids, families, and community members.
Volunteered with SHPE UMich in Guatemala to teach high school students how to build LED circuits, fostering the STEM programs at Instituto Santiago in Guatemala City.

projects.title: Border Crossers
projects.description: Working with artist-in-residence Chico MacMutrie, a team of 20 students from across the schools at U of M came together to build a robotic sculpture that will be deployed at the border of U.S. and Mexico as a political reflection piece.

organizations.name: Society of Hispanic Engineers
organizations.description: "SHPE changes lives by empowering the Hispanic community to realize its fullest potential and to impact the world through STEM awareness, access, support and development."

organizations.name: oSTEM
organizations.description: "oSTEM empowers LGBTQ people in STEM to succeed personally, academically, and professionally by cultivating environments and communities that nurture innovation, leadership, and advocacy."
